name: recurrence-picker
title: Recurrence Picker
description: The body of a repeat popover: presets, a custom editor (every n days, weeks, months or years; weekdays; month day; ends; time) and the host's preview of the next dates. Never computes a date.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing how something repeats — a Repeat property, a schedule, a reminder — inside the host's popover or ResponsiveDialog, with presets built from the record's date and the host's formatted next dates.
meta.whenNotToUse: Picking one date (DatePicker) or a time alone (TimeField); computing occurrences (the host's RRULE engine).
